pages.text: 1. Enter the Nether and look for the $(l)coloured biomes$(): orange groves, grey ash, burning jungles...$(br)2. Mine $(item)Sulfur$() and $(item)Onyx$() (diamond pickaxe).$(br)3. Raid a $(item)Nether Fortress$() for blaze rods: Onyx tools use them as handles.$(br)4. Craft a $(item)Soul Compass$() to find structures.

Three dungeons, three bosses, from easiest to hardest:$(li)$(l)Infernal Sanctum$(): Infernal Warlock$(li)$(l)Withered Catacombs$(): Withered Champion$(li)$(l)Onyx Citadel$(): Onyx Sentinel (drops the $(item)Sentinel Core$() for the $(item)Infernal Heart$())$(br2)Each boss also drops a trophy: the three together summon the $(l)Heart of the Nether$(), the final boss.
